funding.instructions: Use only cash and proceeds already inside the dedicated Robinhood Agentic account. Never pull money from Chase, Crew, Citi, Capital One, any bank, debit card, credit line, or any external account. Only the user may manually add more money. If the user adds more later, the agent may use the newly available non-margin cash under the normal risk rules.

sizing.instructions: Read the dedicated Robinhood Agentic account on every run. Use only current non-margin cash buying power already present there. Convert allocation percentages into dollar amounts at execution time. Never initiate funding or infer external money is available.
